query.adql:
SELECT TOP 200 b.main_id, b.otype, o.description AS otype_label, b.ra, b.dec, b.pmra, b.pmdec, b.nbref, f.V, f.G, f.R, f.J, f.H, f.K
FROM basic AS b
LEFT JOIN otypedef AS o ON b.otype = o.otype
LEFT JOIN allfluxes AS f ON b.oid = f.oidref
WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', b.ra, b.dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 133.761000, -7.242000, 0.141472)) = 1 AND (CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', b.ra, b.dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 133.761000, -7.242000, 0.060500)) = 1 OR DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS', b.ra, b.dec), POINT('ICRS', 133.761000, -7.242000)) <= 0.060500 + SQRT(POWER(b.pmra, 2) + POWER(b.pmdec, 2)) / 3600000.0 * 26.5000)
ORDER BY nbref DESC
